item.title: Trump announced a deal for Hamas to disarm. And, the U.S. economy slowed a bit
item.description: President Trump says a deal has been reached for Hamas to completely disarm and Israeli forces to withdraw from Gaza. And, the U.S. economy slowed some, but Americans continued to spend.

item.title: Trump's noncitizen voter data remains a mystery. But the claims raise midterm fears
item.description: Trump officials say they found 250,000 noncitizens on voter rolls in just four states. Those states don't know where the numbers came from, and some worry what the claims may portend for the midterms.

item.title: At least 18 die after breach of border between Morocco and Spanish territory of Ceuta
item.description: At least 18 migrants have died trying to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta after thousands of people breached the frontier with Morocco and poured in. The crisis boiled over Thursday and overnight.
